tier_reason: Real independent client for a platform with no wrapper alternative (no vanilla-widget equivalent exists for native mobile) -- unlike react/angular this SDK is not redundant with anything, so it stays actively invested even though it currently has the widest gaps of the 5 'core' SDKs.

chat.evidence: flutter/lib/src/resources/chat_resource.dart:36-177 -- get/create/getMessages/sendMessage/markAsRead present; no listConversations, no closeConversation, no sendTyping. Real, concrete gap vs javascript/python/dotnet.

notes: This is the real parity gap in the repo -- not react/angular (deliberately paused) but flutter, which is supposed to be at full parity and is missing listConversations, closeConversation, sendTyping, password reset, and email verification. Since there's no mobile-native alternative to fall back on the way web callers can fall back to the widget, this should be the next active-tier catch-up target, not react/angular.
